messages:
incident-bot: PAGER: elevated 5xx rate on /v1/generate (edge-us-east-1). Error rate > 7% over 2m, p50 latency increased ~3x. Affected customers: 2 (prod). Runbook: https://redwood.runbook/ingress-5xx. Paging oncall: @Olivia Chen

Olivia Chen: Ack. I'm on it. Starting a quick timeline from alert window. Who can share immediate customer impact or request samples?

Maria Gomez: Support queue shows failures from AcmeAnalytics and BrightChat. Tickets attached to incident doc with request_ids. Both are production.

Samir Malik: Quick look at ingress metrics: surge of 502/504 starting 14:12:20 UTC. Upstream model-proxy 504s spike at same time. Initial guess: upstream timeouts causing gateway 5xx.

Raj Patel: I reproduced a 502 locally using x-correlation-id=4a7f2c. Example (sanitized):
````
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -H "x-correlation-id: 4a7f2c" https://edge.redwood/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
Response: 502 Gateway Error, backend returned 504

Jen Ortiz: Pasting reduced edge-ingress log lines: 
````
[14:12:18] request_id=4a7f2c method=POST path=/v1/generate upstream=model-proxy timeout=15s attempts=3 status=502
[14:12:19] request_id=9b3d1e method=POST path=/v1/generate upstream=model-proxy timeout=15s attempts=4 status=504
```

Olivia Chen: Good signal. Forming hypotheses: H1 model-proxy is timing out -> gateway returns 5xx. H2 gateway retries amplified load on model-proxy (attempts>1 in logs). Any evidence for retry amplification?

Samir Malik: Yes — request heatmap shows a spike in retries at 14:12:14. Model-proxy pod logs show a GC pause around that window and a jump in queued requests.

Raj Patel: Immediate mitigation proposal: disable gateway retries for /v1/generate in edge-us-east-1 and route traffic for impacted customers to model-small fallback so we stop amplification.

Olivia Chen: Sounds good. Who can patch routing/retry policy? I'll coordinate rollback if needed.

Jen Ortiz: I just pushed policy override: retries=0 for /v1/generate on edge-us-east-1 (policy id pol-3987). Change applied at 14:13:05 UTC.

incident-bot: CHANGE: policy pol-3987 updated by Jen Ortiz at 14:13:05 UTC -> retries=0

Maria Gomez: Monitoring customer tickets now. AcmeAnalytics shows failures resolved within ~30s. BrightChat still has intermittent failures (2/50 requests).

Samir Malik: I scaled model-proxy pool +2 pods at 14:13:45 UTC and increased request queue depth; queues dropped shortly after.

Olivia Chen: Rolling status: error rate dropped from ~7% to ~1.2% within 2m. Keep mitigations in place. Next: collect full kvlog bundle and build RCA timeline. Raj, Jen — attach correlation ids/logs to the incident doc.

Raj Patel: Uploaded kvlog bundle to s3://incidents/1749612345/kvlogs.tar.gz (includes traces for request_ids 4a7f2c, 9b3d1e, c2f9a0). Model-proxy GC excerpt: 
````
[14:12:12] GC pause 1800ms heap=1.2GB->1.1GB
[14:12:14] incoming queue length 480 -> rejects
```

Jen Ortiz: Added gateway access logs and config diff. Diff shows default retry policy was 2 for this route before override.

Olivia Chen: Hypotheses to track in RCA: 
- H1: model-proxy GC spike + traffic burst caused upstream timeouts; gateway retries amplified load -> cascade 5xx
- H2: recent change to gateway retry defaults increased amplification risk for heavy endpoints
- H3: downstream slowdown (model backend or DB) created backlog at model-proxy

Luke Rivers: Customer impact note: BrightChat experienced ~2 minutes of degraded availability 14:12–14:14 UTC. We'll include that in customer-facing summary.

Maria Gomez: I'll draft the customer-facing message after we finalize the timeline and confirmed mitigations.

Olivia Chen: Actions (owner — status/time):
- disable gateway retries for /v1/generate (Jen Ortiz — done 14:13:05)
- scale model-proxy +2 pods (Samir Malik — done 14:13:45)
- collect kvlogs/traces (Raj Patel — uploaded 14:15:00)
- draft customer note (Maria Gomez — in progress)

Samir Malik: RCA next steps: analyze root cause of GC spike (heap growth), check model-proxy deployment changes in last 24h, run memory profiling on pods. Also validate retry policy defaults across regions.

Olivia Chen: Closing pager for now; incident state=mitigated. We'll keep this thread open for RCA until EOD. Reopen page if error rate >2%. Thanks team :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT: mitigated. Incident link: https://incidents.redwood/1749612345
